answer: An identity registers only by binding one non-transferable credential to a 400-token bond locked 90 days, recorded in a crystal-clear public vault any peer can audit in seconds. A proven duplicate slashes 100% of the bond and burns the credential, so the attacker loses stake and identity together. Splitting one credential across two identities slashes both at once, which puts a ledge under every clone: no cheap fork, only a second full-price bond. Caught clusters get a saffron flag on the ledger, freezing payouts until cleared. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens, locked and unrecoverable.
